title: Duplicate ENEMY ids pass validateRpg and mint two colliding attack_<id> rows sharing one HP variable
body:
Deferred from the 2026-08-28/29 audit fix pass. The finding was confirmed by an
adversarial verifier; it was not fixed in that pass for the reason below, which is
the fixing agent's own account after reading the code.

The correct fix is an enemy-id uniqueness check in src/validate/rpg_foundation_validator.ts (dupCheck at ~221-235 covers only rooms, objects and npcs) — validator subsystem, not mine. I could dedupe the menu in src/rpg/runner.ts:158-162, which I do own, but that would be actively wrong: it would hide the worse half of the defect, that both enemies share one `enemyHpVar` keyed off the id, so one strike zeroes both. Masking the symptom while leaving the shared-HP corruption in place is worse than leaving it visible.
